description: This is a shell script that contains test cases for the git-p4 tool, focusing on relative directory changes with p4, P4CONFIG environment variable usage, symbolic link handling in client root, and cloning repositories with different configurations.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server for testing.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up temporary git repositories after tests.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a git repository.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: p4 client
methods.description: Creates or modifies a Perforce client workspace.
